description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git rev-list' when handling missing objects in a repository, including scenarios with corrupted object files and missing references.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks the result.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after the test case completes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes the command expecting it to fail, used for testing error scenarios.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_oid_to_path
methods.description: Converts a Git object ID to its storage path within the .git directory.
